themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Reviews about push notifications and alerts, including the inability to turn them off in the app, their frequency or content, and whether they clear after being tapped.

themes.name: Streaming reliability
themes.description: Reviews about live and station streams that buffer, cut out, disconnect, fail to connect or stop mid-playback, including drops when switching between WiFi and mobile data.

themes.name: Playlist and queue behavior
themes.description: Reviews about the listening playlist or queue: stories skipping or starting partway through, playlists being erased on close or update, no reordering, and played items not being separated.

themes.name: App crashes and freezes
themes.description: Reviews about the app crashing, freezing, force closing or failing to open, and device-specific glitches such as the lock-screen loop on certain phones.

themes.name: Background activity and battery
themes.description: Reviews about the app running or auto-starting in the background, restarting after being closed, and consuming battery, RAM or data.

themes.name: Media unavailable errors
themes.description: Reviews about stories, programs or hourly news that fail to play, with errors such as 'no audio available' or 'unable to play this media', and programs, topics or stories that will not load.

themes.name: Station finding and local stations
themes.description: Reviews about finding, searching for and selecting local or other NPR stations, favorites and the nearest-station feature, including missing or removed streams.

themes.name: Screen orientation
themes.description: Reviews about the lack of landscape or auto-rotate support, especially on tablets and with stands or keyboards.

themes.name: Chromecast support
themes.description: Reviews requesting or discussing casting to Chromecast or other cast devices.

themes.name: Offline listening and downloads
themes.description: Reviews about downloading or caching audio and articles for offline playback, and avoiding data use.

themes.name: Interface design
themes.description: Reviews about the look, layout, navigation and visual style of the app, including outdated UI, material design, and widget design.

themes.name: Advertisements
themes.description: Reviews about ads in the app, including banner ads that cannot be closed and sponsor messages or ad intros replaying.

themes.name: Political bias
themes.description: Reviews about whether NPR's news coverage is biased, balanced or trustworthy, including claims of liberal or conservative slant.

themes.name: Content freshness and archive
themes.description: Reviews about how current the stories and shows are, how often programs are updated, and access to past episodes or the archive.

themes.name: Missing shows and content
themes.description: Reviews about specific programs or content being absent or removed, such as This American Life, Science Friday or Invisibilia, or too little content.

themes.name: Permissions and privacy
themes.description: Reviews about the permissions the app requests, such as phone ID or call information, and privacy or spyware concerns.

themes.name: SD card and storage
themes.description: Reviews about installing or moving the app to an SD card, internal storage limits, and app size.

themes.name: Article display and images
themes.description: Reviews about article text and images: scrambled or overlapping text, images failing to load, crashes from tapping photos, text size, and missing multimedia.
